decisions: Part 31-batch3: further ZimLII acts under the rule of part 30-batch2: acts enacted after the Law Development Commission's consolidation as at 31 December 2016, as ZimLII publishes them, and older acts whose newest ZimLII version is from 2024 or later; each with every expression ZimLII lists readable and no amendment waiting to be applied.
The acts in this part name ZimLII as their own publisher: the country publisher is Veritas, the source of the Constitution.
ai_use: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5, claude-opus-5-5) wrote the configuration and wrappers and chose the acts; the shared Peachjam adapter does the parsing. No model wrote, summarised or transformed legal text.
